zh.summary: 新增官方 0.2.1-alpha.4 内核可选，预装插件同步升级。
highlights: 可选内核新增 0.2.1-alpha.4（官方最新测试版），列表保留最新三个，并始终包含最新的 RC 版 0.2.0-rc.2。
预装的图片查看器升到 0.1.11、会话管理升到 1.5.12，都已适配 alpha.4。
插件管理页的 Portable 按钮适配了官方 alpha.4 的新页面结构。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。
整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。

en.summary: Adds the official 0.2.1-alpha.4 core as a choice and upgrades the preinstalled plugins to match.
highlights: Selectable cores now include 0.2.1-alpha.4 (the latest official test build); the list keeps the newest three and always includes the newest RC, 0.2.0-rc.2.
The preinstalled Image Viewer is now 0.1.11 and Chat Manager 1.5.12, both adapted to alpha.4.
The Portable buttons on the plugin manager page are adapted to the page structure of official alpha.4.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically.
